title: Bioluminescent Bubble Abyss
description: A dense cluster of translucent, iridescent bubbles or spheres fills the frame, glowing with internal patterns of teal, turquoise, gold, and violet. The bubbles are tightly packed in the lower and middle sections, becoming sparser toward the top against a deep black background, with a dark void-like opening visible in the lower center.
prompt: Dense field of overlapping translucent spheres and bubbles floating in darkness, each sphere filled with intricate swirling patterns and internal glowing colors of teal, turquoise, gold, and violet. The bubbles are tightly clustered in the lower half with a dark void opening in the center, becoming more sparse toward the top against pure black, highly detailed textures, iridescent surfaces, mysterious atmospheric lighting
